PARSER-MYKROBE-SELECTION.title: Selecting one result type crashes a valid parser
PARSER-MYKROBE-SELECTION.impact: Species-only and lineage-only requests raise UnboundLocalError although the full report parses. Each branch now sets its own result-type context.
PARSER-MYKROBE-SELECTION.summary: Both isolated result requests preserve the full-parse value and leave unrequested envelopes skipped.

PARSER-BRACKEN-EMPTY.title: A header-only report is marked parsed with the wrong shape
PARSER-BRACKEN-EMPTY.impact: An empty valid table becomes a nested dictionary instead of the declared result list. The SDK now returns an empty list and an empty envelope.
PARSER-BRACKEN-EMPTY.summary: The header-only case returns empty with value []; numeric zero remains a parsed value.

PARSER-COVERAGE-STREAM.title: Stream input silently loses coverage rows
PARSER-COVERAGE-STREAM.impact: The parser consumes the source and then tries to read it again. Path input works, but a text stream retains only its first row.
PARSER-COVERAGE-STREAM.summary: The parser reads once; both generic rows remain for path and stream input.

DISPLAY-EMM-SUMMARY.title: Stored EMM results are absent from the summary
DISPLAY-EMM-SUMMARY.impact: The template tests emmtype while the current descriptor uses emm. The existing card was never selected.
DISPLAY-EMM-SUMMARY.summary: All 20 stored EMM descriptors now have a reading surface, including two explicit empty reports. A zero cluster count is retained.

screenshots.caption: Before: the stored EMM result has no summary card.
After: the supplied EMM type and cluster are visible alongside MLST.
After: a header-free empty EMM report has explicit empty feedback.

DISPLAY-EMM-TABLE.title: Requested EMM summary columns are silently omitted
DISPLAY-EMM-TABLE.impact: The summary columns read an emm alias, while the builder emits emmtyper. Existing API records contain the value but requested table projections lose it.
DISPLAY-EMM-TABLE.summary: Both projection paths now use the existing alias. All 80 table-summary comparisons pass; all 18 positive EMM records retain the supplied type and cluster. The existing default layout does not request these columns.

screenshots.caption: Configuration gap: the unchanged default overview layout does not offer EMM columns.

DISPLAY-EXTENDED-CONTEXT.title: The extended summary crashes when a stored row needs its record context
DISPLAY-EXTENDED-CONTEXT.impact: An imported card constructs a display link using sample, but the macro import omits context.
DISPLAY-EXTENDED-CONTEXT.summary: The import now receives its context. The previously failing extended summary opens and retains the two frozen species rows; no viewer link or analysis action was executed.

screenshots.caption: Before: the extended summary returns HTTP 500.
After: the same extended summary opens, retaining both source species rows.

DISPLAY-DATABASE-VERSION.title: A shortened version link lacks a full readable label
DISPLAY-DATABASE-VERSION.impact: Recognized database links show only six characters. The full version was present in the URL but absent from visible text or an accessible label.
DISPLAY-DATABASE-VERSION.summary: The existing short link now exposes the full version in its title and accessible label.

screenshots.caption: Before: a stored database version is shown only as a short link label.

PARSER-KLEBORATE-INTEGRATION.title: Kleborate parsing passes, but its stored counterpart is missing
PARSER-KLEBORATE-INTEGRATION.impact: All 20 frozen Kleborate reports parse offline. Earlier ingestion failed, leaving 60 selected fields without stored counterparts across the two assay aliases.
PARSER-KLEBORATE-INTEGRATION.summary: No new upload was attempted in this read-only pass. A separately scoped ingestion test is still needed.

PARSER-TYPING-SURFACES.title: SPA and SCCmec still lack an agreed reading surface
PARSER-TYPING-SURFACES.impact: The selected parser values and stored API values match, but the current summaries offer no corresponding cards.
PARSER-TYPING-SURFACES.summary: The missing controls are recorded as N/A, not passed. The intended release scope needs a product decision.

screenshots.caption: Open scope gap: stored SPA/SCCmec results have no summary reading surface.
